sections.description: Every final journey carries a story. This is the story of a mission built around responsibility, compassion and the belief that no one should be left without dignity.

sections.name: Our Story & Founder Message
sections.title:
One Question
Became a Mission.
sections.subtitle:
What happens when someone passes away
and there is no one to stand beside them?
sections.description:
This question became the foundation of Moksha Sewa—a mission created so that when someone is left without family, support or resources, humanity can still stand beside them.

We believe that every individual, regardless of identity, status or circumstance, deserves a final journey of dignity, respect and compassion.
sections.quote: Dignity should never depend on whether someone has money, family or someone standing beside them.
sections.secondaryDescription: Moksha Sewa is not just a service—it is a promise. A promise that in someone's final moment, humanity will not look away.

items.title: Who can request Moksha Sewa support?
items.description: Moksha Sewa provides support for legally authorised unclaimed bodies, people without family support and verified families facing financial hardship. All requests are subject to verification and eligibility.

items.title: Does Moksha Sewa assist with legally authorised unclaimed bodies?
items.description: Yes. We coordinate support only after the required authority clearance, documentation and legal formalities have been completed.

items.title: What kind of assistance does Moksha Sewa provide?
items.description: Depending on verified need and availability, support may include final-journey transport, ritual materials, priest coordination, cremation-ground support and family guidance.

items.title: Is Moksha Sewa available in my area?
items.description: Moksha Sewa currently focuses on Delhi - Ghaziabad - Noida and is expanding progressively. Contact our team with the case location to confirm availability.

items.title: How can I become a volunteer with Moksha Sewa?
items.description: Submit the volunteer form through our website. Our team will review your details and contact you when a suitable verified opportunity is available.

items.title: How can I support Moksha Sewa through donations?
items.description: You can support verified cases through the official donation page. Contributions are used responsibly for eligible mission activities and case-based assistance.

sections.name: Founder's Vision
sections.title: The Thought Behind Moksha Sewa
sections.description: When a family loses a loved one, they are overwhelmed with grief. At that critical moment, dealing with the logistics of rituals, cremation, and arrangements should not add to their burden. Moksha Sewa was born out of this very realization.
sections.secondaryDescription: Our vision is to provide absolute dignity, complete transparency, and compassionate care to families during their toughest times. Every ritual is guided by deep respect for our traditions, ensuring that the final journey is peaceful and honorable.

items.description: The legal or administrative status of a deceased person is determined by competent authorities under applicable procedures. Moksha Sewa does not independently declare a body to be unclaimed.

items.title: Who can request Unclaimed Body Sewa?
items.description: Hospital authorities, police officers, or verified social workers can notify us.

items.title: What documents or authorisation may be required?
items.description: Police clearance certificates, official hospital handovers, and statutory waiting periods are verified.

items.title: What support can Moksha Sewa provide?
items.description: Final-journey transport, cremation coordination, and basic ritual materials.

items.title: Does Moksha Sewa declare a body legally unclaimed?
items.description: No, we do not declare bodies as unclaimed. We only assist cases authorised by competent authorities.

sections.name: Refund Policy Hero
sections.title: Refund Policy
sections.subtitle: Please read our refund terms carefully
sections.description: At Moksha Sewa, we ensure complete transparency in all our donation and transaction processes. This Refund Policy explains the conditions under which refunds may be considered.

items.title: Overview
items.description: This Refund Policy applies to all donations, payments, registrations and transactions made on the Moksha Sewa website or through authorised channels.

items.title: Donations
items.description: Donations made towards our cause are voluntary and non-refundable. We utilize these funds towards verified humanitarian activities and operational expenses to support our mission.

items.title: Payment Failure or Deduction Without Successful Donation
items.description: If an amount is deducted from your account but the donation is not recorded by us due to a technical error or gateway failure, the full amount will be refunded to your original payment method within 7–10 working days.

items.title: Duplicate Transactions
items.description: In case of duplicate transactions / multiple deductions for the same donation or payment, you are eligible for a full refund of the duplicate amount.

items.title: Event / Campaign Registrations
items.description: Registration fees for events, campaigns or programmes are generally non-refundable. However, if an event is cancelled or postponed by us, we will issue a full refund to registered participants.

items.title: Merchandise / Products
items.description: Refunds are not applicable on purchases of merchandise, books, or other items unless the product is damaged, defective or significantly different from the description provided.

items.title: Volunteer or Other Services
items.description: No refund is applicable for volunteer registrations, membership, or other non-monetary services.

items.title: How to Request a Refund
items.label: Simple steps to request your refund hassle-free.
items.description:
To request a refund, contact us within 7 days of the transaction with your:
• Full name
• Transaction ID / Receipt
• Reason for refund
• Supporting details (if any)

items.title: Refund Process & Timeline
items.label: Know how long it takes to get your refund.
items.description: Once your request is reviewed and approved, refunds will be processed within 7–10 working days to the original payment method.

items.title: Mode of Refund
items.label: Refunds through your original payment method.
items.description: Refunds will be made using the same method through which the original payment was made.

items.title: Chargebacks
items.label: Understand the impact of chargebacks on future donations.
items.description: Initiating a chargeback without contacting us first may affect your ability to make future donations and will incur additional charges, which will be deducted from the refundable amount (if any).

items.title: Partial Refunds
items.description: In certain situations, a partial refund may be considered at our sole discretion depending on the nature of the request and the services or benefits provided.

items.title: Changes to This Policy
items.description: We may update this Refund Policy from time to time. The updated version will be posted on our website.

items.title: Grievance / Contact
items.description: For any refund-related queries or grievances, please contact us.

sections.name: Refund Contact Block
sections.title: Questions About Refunds?
sections.description: If you have any questions about this Refund Policy, please reach out to us.

sections.name: Introduction Text
sections.description: Moksha Sewa (an initiative of Namo Gange Trust) is a non-profit organisation. Donations made to support our humanitarian activities are voluntary and non-refundable except as provided in this Refund Policy.

items.title: Note
items.description:
Refunds are processed only in eligible cases as per this policy.

We request you to read this policy carefully before making any donation or payment.

items.title: Our Commitment
items.description:
We are committed to transparency and accountability in managing all donations.

Every contribution directly supports our mission to serve humanity.
